## Circular to Licensed Corporations

## Facilitation of Lodgment of Annual Returns by Representatives

To facilitate the lodgment of annual returns by licensed representatives, we have designed a checklist  summarizing  the  items  of  information  pertaining  to  which  changes  should  be notified  to  the  Commission  in  accordance  with  the  Securities  and  Futures  (Licensing  and Registration) (Information) Rules (the 'Rules').  The 'Annual Return Checklist for Licensed Representatives' has been posted onto the Commission's website at http://www.sfc.hk/sfc/html/EN/forms/licensing/others/others.html in the "Intermediaries, Licensing  and  Investment  Products"  -  "Forms,  Questionnaires  and  Proforma  documents" section.

The  Rules require licensed representatives to provide a description of their current directorships, partnerships or proprietorships, and the respective dates of such appointments or  commencements  to  the  Commission.    Deemed  or  migrated  licensed  representatives (including responsible officers) who have not provided such information should do so upon submitting their forthcoming annual returns.

If  you  have  any  queries  on  the  above,  please  feel  free  to  contact  your  Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
